pin.longFormSummary:

details.name: Hakata Tonkatsu Tabi to Zen

additionalSources.label: Operator Instagram account (no posts exposed in fetched public page)

details.hoursNote: 27 seats: nine counter seats downstairs, four counter seats and eight table seats upstairs, plus a six-seat private room. Non-smoking; no on-site parking. Dinner reservations only. Call before bringing children. Cards, listed e-money and QR payments accepted. Gozen includes refillable rice, egg, pork soup, mentaiko and pickles; limited wagyu gozen has no published price. Optional additions cost extra. Opening coupon: one soft drink, show when ordering, cannot combine with another coupon, expires October 31. Confirm current menu and prices with the branch.
